name: Escurial (Spain)
description: Square green flag with a white saltire, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Escurial (a tree on white, a castle on red and a chequy field).
history: The arms and the flag of Escurial were approved by the Order of 17 July 1996 of the Consejería de Presidencia y Trabajo published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 1 August 1996, after the municipal council's approval on 27 July 1990.

features.role: Escurial arms — tree, castle and chequy
